segments.text: Three weeks after my diet ended, I stepped on the scale on a Tuesday morning and the number was back.
Same jeans, same mirror, and I had no idea how it happened so fast. That week I found out it wasn't
will power. After a diet, your hunger hormone stays high for months and the fullness signal stays low.
My body was defending its old weight, the hunger was biology, not failure. So now I plan for it.
Protein at breakfast, the measuring cup back on the counter, same play every night.
Save this for your week three, that's when the hunger hits hardest.
